messages:
alex_k: Hey team, quick Q about the upcoming company blackout week — I joined in mid-Nov and only have ~40 hours accrued. There's a bank holiday on Thursday and I'd like to take the Friday 'bridge' day. Are bridge days considered a blackout restriction?

maria_peopleops: Hi Alex :wave: Welcome! Bridge days are not automatically blocked, but during formal blackout windows we ask teams to avoid non-critical PTO. Which blackout are you referring to (end-of-year release vs. company-wide holiday)?

alex_k: It's the end-of-Q4 deploy blackout (the team is oncall that week). Manager said we should keep coverage. I'm not on rotation but would like the day off to travel. Also curious: do new hires get any front-loaded PTO or is it strictly accrual?

sam_dev: FWIW our eng team had one permissive bridge day last year with manager ok — but that was decided in the oncall rota. Might be able to swap shifts.

maria_peopleops: Ok — two parts: coverage and accrual. Coverage: during release blackout we require service coverage; exceptions handled by manager + oncall lead. If taking a bridge day would cause gaps, you'll need to arrange a swap or backup and add that plan to the exception request.

maria_peopleops: Accrual: we do not front-load PTO for most hires. Standard accrual is pro-rated by full months employed using the formula in the handbook: `accrued = annual_alloc * (months_employed / 12)`. For partial months we prorate by days. Example: 15-day month start on Nov 15 -> prorated days count.

peopleops_bot: Reminder: Handbook page: https://intranet.redwood/handbook/leave#accruals (policy version 3.2)

maria_peopleops: Alex — you likely have ~40 hours accurate. If you need an exception during a blackout, please: 1) get manager signoff in thread, 2) submit the "PTO Exception Request" form (link in handbook) with backup coverage details, and 3) we’ll review within 48 hours. Exceptions allowed for travel/commitments but not if it reduces critical coverage.

alex_k: Manager approved if I swap with Sam for pager day on Fri. Sam, can you confirm?

sam_dev: I can swap my Fri pager to Thu — fine with me. Please add the swap details to the form, Alex.

alex_k: Done — filled form, attached note: "swap with Sam_dev, pager covered". Form confirmation #EXC-2045.

maria_peopleops: Got it. We'll review. One note on carryover: if you end the year with unused sick vs. vacation, vacation up to the carryover cap (40h) can be carried; sick does not carry. If this matter affects your year-end balance we'll include pro-rated adjustments.

peopleops_bot: people-ops ticket created: #PTO-7421, reviewer assigned: maria_peopleops. Expected decision by 2025-04-03.

alex_k: Thanks! Appreciate the quick help. :tada:

maria_peopleops: No problem — ping me if you don’t see approval within 48h and congrats on getting coverage sorted :thumbsup:
